name: San Leandro Recreation Counselor-In-Training (CIT)
org: City of San Leandro Recreation and Parks Department
what_you_do: Help at city summer day camps. CITs support games, crafts and group projects with kids and get training that prepares them to be camp staff later.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 17 (2025 guide). You must attend the training days and commit to a 2-week camp session.
pay_detail: This is a volunteer program with a fee. In summer 2025 the fee was $150 for the two training days plus $50 for each 2-week session.
duration: Two training days in mid June, then one or more 2-week sessions (2025: mid June to early August).
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are not posted. In 2025, training days were June 12 and 13 and sessions ran from June 16 to Aug 8. Look for the summer guide in spring 2027.
how_to_apply: Register through the city's online recreation registration (ActiveNet) when the summer guide comes out. Questions: Recreation, (510) 577-3462 or SLRec@SanLeandro.Org.
notes: Fee-based. The 2025 guide listed CIT spots at Chabot Day Camp (Chabot Park) and Camp Hooty Hoo (Bonaire, Halcyon and Washington Manor parks). A Summer 2026 guide was not posted on the Activity Guides page when checked, so 2025 details are used. No CIT listing was found in the online registration system in October 2026.
